DETERMINATION

Following review of the submitted clinical documentation, Northgate Advantage has issued an adverse determination based on medical necessity for the inpatient admission identified above. The documentation available at the time of admission did not meet inpatient criteria.

CRITERIA REVIEWED AND FINDINGS

SEP-01: Not met. Laboratory and vital sign findings did not show sepsis with persistent instability after initial treatment.

SEP-04: Not met. No vasopressor support was required.

No other criteria codes were applied in reaching this adverse determination.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

The following codes apply to this claim:

CARC CO-50
RARC N115

This adverse determination is a medical necessity determination. It was made by a physician reviewer applying the criteria set identified above to the documentation submitted with the claim and any records received during the review period.

APPEAL RIGHTS AND INSTRUCTIONS

A reconsideration request may be submitted within the applicable filing window. The request must include a written clinical rationale that maps each clinical finding to a numbered criterion cited in this notice. Submissions that do not provide this mapping may be returned without substantive review.

Level of care denials are not eligible for provider appeal.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Requests received after that deadline will be closed as untimely.

Supporting documentation, including records generated between [[ADMIT_DATE]] and [[DISCHARGE_DATE]] that were not available at the time of the initial review, should accompany the reconsideration request.

The member is not responsible for charges denied under the codes listed above except as permitted by the member's plan documents and applicable contract terms.

Questions regarding this notice may be directed to the Utilization Management Department using the contact information on the reverse of this letter. Please reference the claim number and member ID in all correspondence.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Northgate Advantage
